description: This header file defines the SignalMasker class, which provides RAII-style management of signal masks for threads, and declares a function to change signal handlers. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and includes signal handling and vector components.

classes.name: SignalMasker
classes.description: A RAII-style class that blocks specified signals for the current thread within its lifetime.

methods.name: SignalMasker
methods.description: Constructor that blocks specified signals until the object is destroyed.

methods.name: ~SignalMasker
methods.description: Destructor that restores the previous signal mask.

methods.name: ChangeSignalHandlers
methods.description: Function to change the handler for given signals.
